title: On the Generation Order in GFlowNets
summary: The v1 experiments isolate generation-order effects in GFlowNets: learned orders improve convergence on selected synthetic tasks, and faster orders show higher gradient signal-to-noise at matched validation loss. The claim is limited to the reported tasks and runs.
ai_technology: neural GFlowNet policies learn backward/generation orders; the source compares five-run convergence and gradient SNR.
